subject: Monitor v2: design the new UX beyond the parity rail
description:
`claude-monitor-v2/` reached PARITY with v1 (fixed rail + single-shell transcript, one search
box, browser-served artifacts, compose/send, pairing) but the new UX the rewrite was actually
for has not been designed.

HELD by the owner on 2026-08-27: "compose/send and pairing first. Hold on to the new UX."
Do not start without an explicit go-ahead.

Background, what landed and why the shape is what it is: design/monitor-v2.md. The four
original goals are listed there; goals 1, 2 and 3 are done. What remains is the interaction
design itself, which is an owner decision, not an implementation gap.

Also still true: v2 is deliberately NOT in the release matrix (.github/workflows/release.yml),
so it ships to nobody until someone adds it.
